title: Optimization & Tuning
summary: This module provides a suite of teleprompters and tools for automatically optimizing DSPy programs. It enables automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and program refinement through techniques like evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, and reinforcement learning.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Optimization Sequence
nodes.title: BetterTogether Meta-Optimizer
nodes.description: A meta-optimizer that combines and sequences various prompt and weight optimization strategies to enhance DSPy programs by leveraging multiple teleprompters.

nodes.label: Optimize Prompts with Bayesian Search
nodes.title: MIPROv2 Optimizer
nodes.description: Optimizes program prompt parameters (instructions and few-shot examples) using Bayesian optimization (Optuna) across multiple stages to find optimal configurations.

nodes.label: Evolve Prompts with Reflection
nodes.title: GEPA Evolutionary Optimizer
nodes.description: An evolutionary optimizer that uses reflection on execution traces to propose and evolve improved instructions for program components, enhancing performance iteratively.

nodes.label: Finetune LM via RL
nodes.title: GRPO Finetune Teleprompter
nodes.description: Applies Grouped Reinforcement Learning with Policy Optimization to finetune language models based on program execution traces and associated rewards, directly improving LM behavior.

nodes.label: Dynamically Select Demos
nodes.title: KNN Few-Shot Selector
nodes.description: Selects the k-nearest neighbor examples from a training set at inference time to dynamically provide highly relevant few-shot demonstrations, improving context for the LM.

nodes.label: Refine Instructions with Feedback
nodes.title: Feedback-Based Instruction Refinement
nodes.description: Generates new or improved instructions for program components by analyzing positive and negative execution examples and incorporating specific feedback.

nodes.label: Generate Program Instructions
nodes.title: Program-Grounded Instruction Generation
nodes.description: Creates instructions for specific modules within a larger program by first understanding the program's overall structure, individual module roles, and dataset characteristics.

nodes.label: Induce Natural Language Rules
nodes.title: Natural Language Rule Induction
nodes.description: Extracts concise and non-redundant natural language rules from successful program executions or examples, integrating them into predictor instructions for clearer guidance.

nodes.label: Capture Program Execution Trace
nodes.title: Program Execution Tracer
nodes.description: Patches a program's forward method to capture its detailed execution trace, including inputs, outputs, intermediate steps, and handling of parsing errors, for analysis.

nodes.label: Generate Module Feedback
nodes.title: Module-Specific Feedback Generator
nodes.description: Generates concrete, actionable advice for individual modules within a program by contrasting good and bad execution trajectories, helping modules learn from past performance.

nodes.label: Analyze Dataset Characteristics
nodes.title: Dataset Descriptor & Summarizer
nodes.description: Analyzes sample data points to describe dataset trends, topics, content, and syntax, and summarizes observations to inform instruction generation and optimization strategies.

nodes.label: Calculate Performance Metrics
nodes.title: Program Quality & Usage Metrics
nodes.description: Computes average and best quality scores for proposed programs and logs token usage by language models during trials, providing key performance indicators.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Program Module
nodes.description: The core DSPy program or module that is the target for optimization and tuning.

nodes.label: Training Data
nodes.title: Training Dataset
nodes.description: A collection of input-output examples used to guide the optimization process, providing ground truth and performance signals.

nodes.label: Evaluation Metric
nodes.title: Program Evaluation Metric
nodes.description: A function used to score the performance of a DSPy program on given examples, providing the objective for optimization.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: The underlying large language model used by DSPy predictors, whose behavior or prompting is being optimized.

groups.label: Optimization Algorithms (Teleprompters)
groups.title: Core Optimization Algorithms
groups.description: The primary algorithms and meta-optimizers that drive the tuning process, employing various strategies like Bayesian search, evolutionary methods, and reinforcement learning to improve DSPy programs.

groups.label: Instruction & Prompt Refinement
groups.title: Instruction & Prompt Engineering
groups.description: Components focused on generating, refining, and managing the textual instructions and few-shot examples that guide language models within DSPy programs.

groups.label: Performance Analysis & Data Insights
groups.title: Program Analysis & Feedback
groups.description: Tools for evaluating program execution, gathering detailed feedback, analyzing dataset characteristics, and tracking performance metrics to inform the optimization process.

groups.label: Core Optimization Inputs
groups.title: Essential Optimization Inputs
groups.description: The fundamental external elements required for any optimization process, including the DSPy program itself, training data, evaluation criteria, and the underlying language model.
